notes: Squarespace USD rates are from Squarespace's pricing data file, which lists monthly billing, the annual plan's per-month equivalent, and the annual total. The public pricing page shows Basic at $25/mo and $19/mo and says paying annually saves up to 36%.

Wix figures are yearly subscriptions shown as a per-month price and paid in full up front. The Wix pages checked for this file did not publish a separate month-to-month dollar amount, so this calculator does not invent one.
A domain is about $12 a year either way and is not added on top. Squarespace says an annual plan includes one year of domain registration on its cheapest tier.
No add-on prices (email marketing, booking apps) are included. This pass did not pull official add-on price lists.

wix.billingNote: Yearly price, shown per month. Month-to-month dollar amounts were not published on these pages.
